title: Helper serves a card
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  a["startServer() opens the port"] --> b["token check on x-docviz-token"]
  b --> c["pickProvider() chooses claude or codex"]
  c --> d["card JSON back to the tab"]

title: Finding a CLI
One completion
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant S as server
  participant P as complete()
  participant C as runClaude()
  S->>P: job + timeout
  P->>C: prompt on stdin
  C-->>P: JSON + total_cost_usd
  P-->>S: card + usage

title: Codex cost estimate
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  a["runCodex() streams events"] --> b["parseCodexEvents"]
  b --> c["codexUsage() sums tokens"]
  c --> d["~$ estimate, estimated: true"]

title: Painting a picture
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  a["card.picture brief"] --> b["illustratePrompt() writes the ask"]
  b --> c["codex paints a PNG"]
  c --> d["renderPicture() shows it under the card"]

title: Charging a card
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  a["createLedger()"] --> b["usage from helper"]
  b --> c["addCost() to card"]
  c --> d["daily total"]

title: Daily budget
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  a["breakdown requested"] --> b["spendToday()"]
  b --> c{"over budget?"}
  c -- yes --> d["budgetRefusal() shown"]
  c -- no --> e["cards generated"]

title: Break down this page
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant T as tab
  participant B as breakdown()
  participant H as helper
  T->>B: sections
  B->>B: batchSections()
  B->>H: POST /v1/cards
  H-->>B: cards + usage
  B-->>T: insert cards

title: Visualize a selection
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  a["right-click selection"] --> b["visualizeSelection()"]
  b --> c["callHelper('/v1/card')"]
  c --> d["card under the selection"]

title: Undoing a learned pref
mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> AsSet
  AsSet --> Adjusted: learn() after Simpler twice
  Adjusted --> AsSet: undoPref()
  Adjusted --> Adjusted: more cards

title: Drawing a card
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  a["card.mermaid"] --> b["renderDiagram() strict"]
  b --> c["svg in frame"]
  c --> d["applyZoom()"]

title: Explore mode
mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant U as reader
  participant E as renderExplore()
  participant H as helper
  U->>E: opens the sandbox
  E->>H: explorePrompt() with sandbox rules
  H-->>E: simulation HTML
  E-->>U: sandboxed frame

title: docviz pr
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  a["steps.json"] --> b["runPr()"]
  b --> c["card from provider"]
  c --> d["prComment() with code table"]

title: Linking steps to lines
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  a["step from/to markers"] --> b["cut() finds lines"]
  b --> c["link at HEAD"]
  c --> d["sumUsage() for footer"]

title: Syntax check
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  a["mermaidChecker() launches chromium"] --> b{"parse ok?"}
  b -- no --> c["repair call"]
  b -- yes --> d["footer: docvizVersion()"]

title: Pairing code
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  a["docviz code"] --> b["loadConfig()"]
  b --> c{"token saved?"}
  c -- no --> d["newCode()"]
  c -- yes --> e["print token"]
